changes: Five new road car cups: Five cups for road car fans: a 911 Turbo 3.6 Cup, NSX Legends, an American Muscle Championship and a Green Hell Tourist Trophy at B level, plus a 288 GTO Trophy at International level.

International licence: new medal times: Medal times in the International licence tests follow a tester's times: gold takes a few attempts, silver is one or two seconds behind and bronze leaves plenty of room for pad drivers.
